workflow_runs.name: Native Agent R1 components and package
workflow_runs.display_title: Preserve owned bookmarks when Chrome lookup fails for another reason

head_commit.message:
Preserve owned bookmarks when Chrome lookup fails for another reason

Constraint: Only the observed missing-node rejection may release a deleted bookmark reference
Rejected: Substring matching for find bookmark/no bookmark | Also accepts permission, service and malformed-ID failures
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Unknown Chrome lookup errors must retain the mapping and never issue remove
Tested: Controlled Chrome155 read-only getters with real extension/context and owned cleanup; Bookmarks9/9 including six unrelated error shapes
Not-tested: Installed-tool optional permission consent, external-delete UI, Worker restart and full same-candidate SDK native acceptance
